facts.fact: The press release says decree 2024-047/PR of 30 September 2024 appointed Lt-Col Bediani Belei, as head of the IPDCP, the authority created by law no. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019, marking the start of its operationalisation.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel (IPDCP)

facts.fact: The press release describes law no. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 as the law in force in Togo whose compliance the IPDCP oversees.
